run_object_detection_pipeline: run an object detection pipeline on an image using the DETR ResNet-50 model
test_object_detection_with_threshold: test the object detection pipeline by filtering results with a confidence threshold
create_object_detection_pipeline: create an object detection pipeline using AutoModelForObjectDetection and AutoImageProcessor from a pretrained model
run_batch_object_detection: run batch object detection on multiple images including URLs and PIL Image objects
test_layoutlm_object_detection: test object detection on document images using a LayoutLMv3 fine-tuned model
